# f5xc_tf_params_action (Resource)

Run Terraform Action for view perform terraform actions for a given view. Supported actions are apply and plan.

To get more information about f5xc_tf_params_action, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-terraform-parameters)



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `view_kind` (String) Kind of View Kind of view of which terraform parameters are requested e.g. aws_vpc_site, azure_vnet_site
- `view_name` (String) Name of view Name of the view for which terraform parameters are requested

### Optional

- `action` (List of String) Terraform action to be performed Terraform action to be performed for a given view e.g. plan, apply<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['APPLY', 'DESTROY', 'PLAN']`<br>**Default:** `APPLY`
- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace for the label to be retrieved
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Wait for terraform action job completion before returning result.

### Read-Only

- `tf_output` (String) Terraform output emitted by apply action when wait_for_action is enabled.
